source.title: Achievements in Implementing the Strategic Action Programme in the Philippines during 2008-2021
source.project: Implementing the Strategic Action Programme for the South China Sea and Gulf of Thailand
source.meeting: First Meeting of the Regional Scientific and Technical Committee, Bangkok, 17-19 October 2022
source.retrieval: Official 13-page project PDF reviewed through its indexed text; no local copy retained.

findings.namedSite: The report has a Maragondon River Estuary section and refers to the Maragondon River mouth in Ternate management context. This supports a source-named research lead, not a precise wetland or channel boundary.
findings.reportingPeriod: The evaluation describes implementation during 2008-2021 and was presented in October 2022.

monitoringPlan.sourceReported: Ternate Marine Park was planned to undergo biodiversity monitoring through BMS at four stations twice a year and BAMS every three years.
monitoringPlan.interpretation: A plan in a 2022 evaluation does not establish that surveys took place. No station coordinates, dates, results, taxa, or reports were provided.

managementAreaClaim.sourceReported: The report states that the Maragondon River mouth MPA declared under Ternate Ordinance No. 2 S-2011 covers 35,700 ha.
managementAreaClaim.decision: Not adopted as the estuary area, a verified protected-area boundary, or water geometry. The underlying ordinance/map and unit were not independently verified.

findings.fishEvidence: No fish species or fish survey results are given in the reviewed estuary/monitoring passage. River-level Maragondon fish studies are not assigned to this estuary without a station-to-reach crosswalk.
findings.salinity: No estuary-specific salinity measurements or classification were found in this report.

nextAction: Seek the underlying Ternate Marine Park management plan, Ordinance No. 2 S-2011 and its map, plus any BMS/BAMS field reports with dates, station coordinates, and biological results. Until these are reviewed, keep the estuary geometry, salinity and estuary-specific fish coverage unresolved.
